Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

**Job Summary**

  

In this customer‑facing role, you will lead and manage the on‑boarding process for new Employee Benefits groups in the small‑case market. You’ll gather and validate sold‑case information, coordinate with internal partners to ensure accurate contract drafting and billing, guide customers through installation, and deliver a smooth, informed transition to ongoing service. You’ll use your understanding of the on‑boarding lifecycle to resolve issues, build trust with customers, and bring forward insights that support continuous improvement.

* Submit accurate group data to Policyholder Services and partner through the scrub process.

Bring customer insights to continuous improvement efforts and collaborate on process enhancements.  

  

**Skills and Background You’ll Need**

  

**Education:** High School Diploma or Equivalent, Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Experience:** 3+ years of group insurance experience, including employee benefits and direct customer interaction.

* Experience in project management, benefits administration, case management, customer service, or sales.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve customer issues and manage complex on‑boarding activities.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
* Background collaborating with cross‑functional teams in a process‑driven environment.
Familiarity with contract setup, billing processes, or Policyholder Services operations.  

  

**Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate**

  

* **Adaptability:** Adjusts quickly to changing priorities and sees possibilities in evolving circumstances.
* **Customer Focus:** Builds trust through clear communication, proactive problem solving, and ownership of outcomes.
* **Winning Together:** Works effectively with diverse internal and external partners to move work forward.

**Why Join The Standard?**
==========================

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

* A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
* An annual incentive bonus plan
* Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure
* A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement
* Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance
* An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about *working at The Standard.*

$66,000.00 - $96,250.00

jobs.title: SaaS Implementation - Remote
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Implementation Specialist – FinTechAccounting SaaS**
=======================================================================

**Location:** Remote (US – MT, CT, or ET hours)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Compensation:** $70,000 – $90,000 Base Salary ($80,000 – $100,000 OTE) + Competitive Equity  

### **Role Overview**

A high-growth FinTech and B2B SaaS company specializing in AI-driven close management and general ledger connectivity is seeking an Implementation Specialist to drive client onboarding. Functioning as an SMB Customer Success Manager, you will serve as the dedicated primary advisor for small-to-mid-sized accounting and bookkeeping firms through their critical first 90–100 days of software adoption.  
This role bridges accounting domain expertise with hands-on SaaS customer success, ensuring new clients seamlessly integrate the software into their daily financial workflows and realize immediate time-to-value.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Implementation Management:** Oversee the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for a portfolio of bookkeeping and accounting practices serving 10–50 clients per month.
* **Consultative OnboardingTraining:** Lead comprehensive 1-hour initial onboarding calls via Zoom covering technical setup and platform fundamentals. Run targeted follow-up syncs (15–45 minutes) addressing advanced feature training, workflow optimizations, and team enablement.
* **Customer SuccessRetention:** Serve as the trusted first point of contact for customer inquiries throughout the 90–100 day implementation phase to secure high long-term retention and renewal rates before transitioning accounts to standard support.
* **ProductWorkflow Advocacy:** Actively capture client feedback, integration hurdles, and feature requests to guide product roadmap enhancements and streamline internal onboarding playbooks.

### **Candidate Profile**

* **AccountingBookkeeping Expertise:** 2–3 years of direct experience in bookkeeping or accounting workflows, bringing a solid grasp of general ledgers and financial close processes.
* **SaaS Customer Success Orientation:** Prior experience in a customer-facing B2B SaaS onboarding, implementation, or customer success role is strongly preferred.
* **FinTechCore Tool Proficiency:** Familiarity with modern accounting platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) alongside customer success and CRM tooling (e.g., Salesforce, Intercom, Notion, Calendly, Loom, Gong).
* **Customer-Centric Execution:** Highly proactive, coachable, and empathetic communicator who excels in an individual contributor role guiding clients through operational change.
* **Career Foundation:** At least 2 years of full-time professional career tenure.

### **CompensationWork Environment**

* **Target Earnings:** $70,000 – $90,000 base salary with an on-target earnings (OTE) potential of $80,000 – $100,000.
* **Equity:** Meaningful equity grant included.
* **Remote Schedule:** 100% remote within the United States, operating 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) aligned to Mountain, Central, or Eastern time zones.
* **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (e.g., US Citizens or Permanent Residents).

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks like**:

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  
  
First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.  
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

* Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
* 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
* Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

**What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!**  
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!  
  
***The salary range for this position is approximately $80-90K USD annually.*** *This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.*

**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!**

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

  

**CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:**

* Bonus Incentives
* Paid Certifications
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Comprehensive Benefits
* Career Advancement
* This position pays between $22.45 - $26.35/hr based on experience
* This position is a temporary role

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare.

The HR Onboarding Specialist is responsible for managing the onboarding, compliance, and occupational requirements for all hires joining Ensemble. This includes both traditional hires and those joining via client integrations. The HR Onboarding Specialist is an integral part of the business ensuring an elevated new hire experience while managing the complexities of client onboarding requirements.

**Job Competencies:**

**Valuing Differences** - Works effectively with individuals of diverse cultures, interpersonal styles, abilities, motivations, or backgrounds; seeks out and uses unique abilities, insights, and ideas. Considers the collective.  
**Collaboration** - Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It’s “All for One and One for All”.  
**Accountability** - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed. Someone who is willing to step up and own it.  
**Developing Trust** - Gains others’ confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges.  
**Takes Initiative** - Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly.  
**Time Management** - Effectively manages personal time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.

**Essential Job Functions:**

  

* Manage onboarding and occupational health requirements for assigned book of business. This includes new client intake discussions, identifying process bottlenecks, and creating streamlined approaches to maximize efficiencies.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures on assigned book of business to train peers and support cross functional collaboration across the team.
* Interpret occupational health medical results and determine appropriate vaccinations required based on assigned clients to ensure compliance with Joint Commission requirements.
* Responsible for navigating conversations with new hires and integrating associates to guide them through the onboarding process and ensure all items are completed timely and compliantly.
* Provide exceptional candidate experience to new hires while maintaining strong relationships and communication across all internal and external onboarding partners including background and occupational health vendors, HR, Talent Acquisition, and hiring leadership teams.
* Review onboarding requirements for accuracy and determine employment eligibility based on findings.
* Consistent partnership with Talent Acquisition Leadership to review escalations and proactively mitigate risks.
* Navigate difficult conversations with heightened discretion to properly rescind offers, push start dates, and discuss background findings with new hires while maintaining confidentiality.
* Maintain understanding of internal and external system integrations to troubleshoot any system gaps and enable cross functional collaboration with our IT, Workday, and External partners.
* Continuously refine and implement onboarding controls and audits to reduce risk.
* Execute additional HR projects as assigned.

**Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar field, talent onboarding experience is preferred
* Clear communication and problem solving skills required
* Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience

##### **Your Impact**

Own your opportunity to be on the frontlines of health innovation. Deliver for America’s health agency missions and enhance lives for hundreds of millions every day.

**Job Description**
-------------------

At GDIT, we put our people first. As a Senior Business Analyst supporting the Indian Health Service, you will be entrusted to work with clinicians, developers, and federal staff to document changes and requirements for clinical applications.

  

This a REMOTE BASED ROLE. Candidate must live in the US.

\*\* Work visa sponsorship will no be provided for this position \*\*

  

**How the Senior Business Analyst will make an Impact:**

* Analyze user and stakeholder needs to define functional and non-functional requirements across projects for the electronic health record system.
* Document and manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle within the requirements repository (Azure DevOps).
* Perform functional modeling to support requirements analysis and solution design.
* Manage project backlogs and support prioritization activities.
* Consult with clients to determine optimal design solutions for assigned projects.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including requirements documents, user manuals, addendums, presentations, and training materials.
* Assist in developing test use cases and scripts for user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with software development teams and comply with contract reporting requirements.
* Collect and report metrics related to requirements and client-identified priorities.
* Respond to inquiries from clients, clinicians, field personnel, developers, and other stakeholders.
* Provide status reports to the PMO and/or Lead Analyst.
* Participate in special projects as assigned.
  

**What You Will Need to Succeed:**

* Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, and work experience as described below.
* 8+ years of technical requirements analysis and Requirements Engineering (RE) experience using Waterfall and Agile SDLC methodologies.
* Experience creating process and data flow diagrams, prototypes, and wireframes.
* Experience managing change control activities, including backlog management, scope control, and impact/gap analysis.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of applications, including Microsoft Visio.
* Experience writing use cases and user stories.
* Ability to clearly explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated success working in a collaborative team environment with shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Proven ability to work on a remote or geographically dispersed team.
* Minimal travel (once per year) may be required.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* IIBA certification Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA).
* Experience working with and knowledge of electronic health record systems (EHR, Pharmacy, Immunizations, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Quality Reporting) highly desired
* Experience with the Indian Health Service RPMS and/or Veterans Administration VistA EHR systems.
* Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and/or Team Foundation Server.
* Knowledge of Planview and/or Unanet.
  

**Location:** Remote within the USA

  

**Clearance Level:** Requires the ability to pass an IHS background check and meet the residency requirement for having resided in the US at least (3) three out of the last (5) five years in order to obtain an appropriate level Public Trust Level 5 (MBI or T2) clearance.

* Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home, with core work hours Monday – Friday 9:00 AM ET – 3:00 PM local time.
* 401K with company match.
* Comprehensive health and wellness packages.
* Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career.
* Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications.
* Cutting-edge technology you can learn from.
* Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays.
* Challenging work that makes a real impact on the world around you.
* Remote work.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application  
**Location:** Riedman - Remote  
**Hours Per Week:** 40  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Day-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am - 4:00 pm)

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
STAR Autism Support has several openings for Training Specialists! STAR Training Specialists are responsible for delivering side by side coaching and consultation to educators and staff serving students pre-K through secondary on how to implement SAS curriculum tools in the classroom.

STAR Autism Support (SAS) is a family-founded educational consulting company based in Portland, OR. SAS provides curriculum materials, workshops and training to school and agency staff who work with students with autism and other developmental disabilities. Our unique and practical approach provides school districts with curriculum resources and a continuum of professional development activities to address the educational needs of student’s early childhood through post-secondary throughout the country and internationally. At SAS our goal is to cultivate a supportive, positive and welcoming work environment where all staff can successfully thrive. We value and celebrate equity, diversity, and inclusion. Our vision of equity includes a continuous commitment to becoming an antiracist, multicultural organization. We strive to provide all employees with a culture of curiosity and continued learning.

**Training Specialist candidates must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:**

**1) A minimum of 1 year experience using or implementing STAR curriculum or Links products in a classroom setting**

**2) Live within 30 miles (<1 hour drive) of a regional or major airport**

**3) Able to start this new role in January 2027**

**Title:** Training Specialist  
  
**Schedule:** Full-Time; variable hours with average of 40 per week  
  
**Location:** U.S. - Remote with travel (work from home and travel to customer locations)  
  
**Salary Range:** $65,000 - $85,000 annually

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**.

* Provide training and consultation to school districts and agencies in implementing curricula for students with autism spectrum disorders and other developmental disabilities.
* Provide educators with in-class coaching using best practices for adult learning.
* Collaborate with sales professionals, customer success specialists, and district administration to build the capacity of district programs to provide evidence-based practices.
* Complete consultation notes and gather classroom performance data to support requirements of customer programs and grants.
* Collaborate with the sales and customer success teams to share customer dynamics, priorities, and progress so they may offer the most appropriate solutions based on individualized needs and goals.
* Keep current on research-based knowledge of ASD and effective instructional strategies.
* Provide personal and customer feedback to our product team to promote ongoing improvements of our curricular tools.
* Support with in-person and virtual workshops, consultations, and presentations on SAS curricula (STAR, Links, SOLS, SOLER, etc.) and strategies for educators, caregivers, and staff using SAS professional development tools.
* Responsible for booking travel accommodations (flights, rental car, hotel) once monthly schedule has been provided; track expenses and reimbursements and submit via company protocol.

**Required Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in education or related fields
* Minimum of 3 years of experience using evidence-based practices working with students with autism spectrum disorders
* 1+ years of experience using the STAR curriculum or Links program in classroom settings
* Ability to travel domestically (via car and air travel), including some weekend travel
* Excellent interpersonal, presentation, teamwork, written, and oral communication skills
* Effective observation, consultation, and data collection skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree and/or BCBA

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Organizational KSA’s

* Strong verbal and written business communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively
* Has a growth mindset, is curious, and interested in ongoing learning and development
* Adaptable and easily able to pivot as needed
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Self-motivated and proficient at working both independently and as part of a team
* Intermediate Microsoft office skills and competence in a digital environment

Role KSA’s

* Passionate about teaching evidence-based practices to educators
* Committed to excellence in all work—working nonstandard hours when necessary, anticipating issues, performing creative problem-solving, and communicating with diplomacy
* Ability to work collaboratively with education staff, caregivers/parents, administrators, and students
* Intermediate to advanced experience with online web-based tools such as Microsoft Office 365, Zoom, PowerPoint, and Teams as well as ability to learn new software, tech equipment, tools and assistive devices quickly
* Ability to develop and maintain positive relationships with clients and colleagues while exemplifying STAR values
* Ability to communicate well with people at all levels of an organization (e.g. listen to understand, explain ideas simply, ability to give and receive feedback)

**Travel**  
This position requires a combination of local and travel services (via car and air) where you will work away from your home office. Travel may include classroom visits, workshops, trade shows/conferences and other business-related purposes. Trainers may need to work or travel on weekends or adapt working hours to meet travel needs. Expected service days are a minimum of 12 per month and a maximum of 18 days per month, not including travel to and from the location. Assignments are based on trainer fidelity, customer location and service day requirements, which will impact each training specialist’s number of service days per month.

**Physical Demands (Capability Requirements)**  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to enter text or data into a computer by means of a keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to sit for long periods of time and is required to stand and walk around for long periods of time. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move between 10-25 pounds, with or without assistance. The employee is required to express or exchange ideas verbally to impart oral information and to convey detailed spoken instructions. Specific vision abilities required by this job include clarity of vision including reading small print and the use of computers. Specific hearing abilities required include the ability to hear, understand, and distinguish speech in person and over the phone.

**The perks of working with us**  
Not only are you helping do good in the world, but you will be joining a team of passionate and exceptional people within a casual environment. We offer a full suite of benefits including:

* Retirement plan options with company matching
* Generous paid time off, including paid holidays and office closure days
* Paid COVID-19 sick leave
* Health Insurance Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Flexible Spending Accounts)
* Life and Disability Insurance options
* Employee Assistance Program

We are a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. STAR Autism Support (SAS) is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). We celebrate the differences that make each person unique, both at work and in the communities we serve. Using evidence-based practices we strive every day to make positive educational outcomes accessible to all students and educators. This commitment is also foundational to our company culture. We acknowledge that research shows that Black, Indigenous and people of color (BIPOC) and women are significantly less likely to apply for some positions, believing they must meet every qualification as described in the job description. At STAR Autism Support, we value representation, and we are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job. We know that sometimes that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described in the job description.

GP Strategies Government Solutions is seeking an **SAP SuccessFactors Implementation Project Manager.** This is a full-time, remote, benefitted position. The Project Manager is capable of simultaneously managing all aspects of assigned projects, interfacing with the client, project team members, and senior management to meet both client and company expectations. The SuccessFactors Project Manager is expected to manage and deliver large and small-scale IT projects on time and within budget while overseeing all phases from project planning to project closure.

**Role and Responsibilities**

Operational

* Capable of wearing multiple hats simultaneously (i.e., strategic, and operational)
* 5 or more years’ experience with PMO team management, sales support, quality control, account management, operations management, team management (10 or more), project management (3 or more simultaneously)
* Facilitate/support Client Relationship Management shared with sales/others where applicable
* Experienced and capable of managing Organic Growth (upsell scope, projects, support)
* Facilitate/support Customer Satisfaction/Referenceable
* Facilitate/support SAP/NS2 relationships, strategic relationships, internal relationships
* Able to manage dedicated resources and shared resources across peer verticals & horizontal business units.
* Able to lead, mentor, and support project managers overseeing the successful deployment and delivery of SAP SuccessFactors projects.
* Ability to manage difficult high stress client escalations and negotiations.
* Manage the team ensuring quality and cost-effective services are provided.
* Ability to Identify and deploy process, system, execution, documentation, etc. improvements.
* Ability to collaborate with and solicit (open to) input from senior leadership, peers, directs, external partners, and customers.

Project Accountability

* Serve as the single point of accountability for all aspects of their assigned project(s).
* Direct and control all activities to align on and meet client expectations and meet budgeted financial objectives tied to the project.
* Track all project costs to budget, project progress to schedule, and prepare cost-to-complete reports.
* Obtain required approvals for documentation, stage gates, etc. (e.g. requirements, workbooks, testing results, etc.).

Project Execution

* Project Preparation: Create project plans, create kick off presentations, forecasting, resource plan, sales to delivery hand off, client engagement, etc.
* Maintain project documentation and prepare/deliver project progress reports.
* Conduct internal project review meetings and act as project information source.
* Perform final review of deliverables.
* Monitor project deliverables to ensure quality is maintained.
* Ensure that deliverables are on time, and on/under budget.
* Identify and mitigate project risks.
* Develop and maintain detailed project schedules and project forecasts for resource planning.
* Manage project scope and change management activities.

Project/Client Communication

* Manage and lead client communications.
* Establish a trusted partner relationship with client project stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary client interface for project schedule, budget, and scope.
* Maintain routine communications with the management concerning all aspects of the project.
* Support the development of proposals by providing estimates for support activities.
* Strive to identify organic growth opportunities with the client.

Resource Management

* Coordinate and direct the staff assigned to the project, i.e. the project team.
* Maintain a positive working environment with the project team.
* Coach, counsel, and mentor project team members on project related.
* Identify and help determine resources needed on potential projects.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5+ years managing projects, including defining project scope and budget, creating project plans, managing project resources, issue resolution, and reporting status.
* Experience managing SuccessFactors full-suite implementations.
* Experience managing ECP payroll implementations.
* Experience using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet’s, etc.
* Experience using resource and financial management tools such as Oracle, Salesforce, etc.
* Detailed and results oriented individual who takes initiative to solve problems and overcome roadblocks in a timely manner.
* Ability to communicate with team members and customers clearly, concisely, and confidently, both verbal and written.
* Ability and desire to share knowledge with customers and mentor the project team.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
* Ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving, fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work closely with multiple internal and external organizations.
* Ability to multitask while managing multiple technical projects, oversee daily project operations, and support other projects in a contributor role.
* US Citizen
* Able to pass background checks and public trust clearance if/when needed for assignments.
* Ability to travel up to 25% as needed.

Preferred:

* Experience implementing EC for existing SAP ECC Payroll customers remaining on ECC Payroll.
* Experience with ECC Payroll to ECP Payroll implementations.
* Willing to remain current with SAP/SuccessFactors HCM technologies.
* Knowledgeable in current HR policies, practices, and ability to anticipate future trends affecting the business from a systems and process perspective.

Plus:

* Experience configuring, implementing, and supporting one or more SAP HCM/Payroll and or SuccessFactors modules.
* Ability to elicit and document business requirements.
* Knowledge of technical data processing procedures, policies, and best practices.

Requirements:

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**General physical requirements needed to perform the essential functions of this job may vary based on location of assignment.**

***Assignment Location – Remote***

* Sedentary Work – Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.
* Typing, communicating, repetitive motions.
* Close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data, view computer monitors and read. May need to view presentation screens and other visual aids in a virtual setting.
* Inside environmental conditions with protection from outside elements.
